title: Configuration with Two Head Positions Set
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of an $m$-tape machine on input $x$, let $s$ be a state, let $r_1,r_2$ be work-tape indices, and let $k$ be an integer. The resulting configuration has state $s$, the same input-head position, work-tape contents, and output as $c$, and has both work-tape heads at indices $r_1$ and $r_2$ positioned at $k$; if the indices coincide, that head is positioned at $k$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration on input $x$ with $m$ work tapes
